and KG hints, Crossings","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Crossings

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
A lone crossbuck asks readiness to stop, flashing lights command a full stop until all is clear, and gates hold you until they rise [A01].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec04-F11, sec04-F12, sec04-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
Advance crossing signs upstream ask for looking, listening, and slowing, while the crossbuck at the rails marks the decision point itself [A01].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F10, sec04-F11 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
One track threatens trains from either direction, while multiple tracks threaten either direction on either track plus a second train from the opposite way [A01].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F11, sec04-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A01
A Y junction only forks your path right or left, while a T junction ends your road at a stop sign with a forced turn and yield [A01].
Why it matters: group curve-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A01
Low ground crossings threaten to hang low vehicles on the rails, while open and expansion joints threaten motorcycle control and wet traction [A01].
Why it matters: group curve-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F09, sec04-F01, sec04-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A01
Single sharp turns and double sharp turns each warn of one hard bend sequence, while winding road warns of a whole series of curves [A01].
Why it matters: group curve-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07, sec04-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A02
A moving car must never enter the crossing without a guaranteed clear exit, while a stalled car must be abandoned for a diagonal run toward the train side [A02].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec04-F15, sec04-F18 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A02
Work-zone speeding convictions reach five hundred dollars, while handheld device use draws a flat two hundred fifty [A02].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F19 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A02
Arrow boards redirect lanes, flaggers personally stop and steer traffic, and photo signs warn that cameras enforce the limit [A02].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F22, sec04-F23, sec04-F24 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A02
School buses always stop at crossings even with dark lights, while dangerous crossing conditions go to the railroad by emergency-sign phone call [A02].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F16, sec04-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A02
Inside the device line you hold the lane middle at the posted speed, and past the zone you keep lane and speed until fully clear [A02].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F25 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]
